description: Changes the CPU's FIRMWARE version IN-PLACE (wraps DeviceItem.ChangeType), PRESERVING the program — an alternative to delete+recreate (enables 'auto-FW-match'). Guard Gd5: the typeIdentifier follows 'OrderNumber:<MLFB>/V<fw>' with '/V' (slash), never ':V' — resolve via tia_catalog. Rule: the PROJECT's firmware version must be ≤ the physical DEVICE's (project FW ≤ device FW). dryRun (Gd11) returns the plan without mutating. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/device/changeversion. Class M-off.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

plc.description: name of the PLC (CPU) whose firmware will be changed

typeIdentifier.description: OrderNumber:<MLFB>/V<fw> of the target firmware (Gd5; resolve via tia_catalog) — e.g.: "OrderNumber:6ES7 214-1HG40-0XB0/V4.4"

name: tia_device_change_version
title: TIA — change CPU firmware (in-place)
